translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Tobaiasa Labaelela Laguele andaga anda penego ogo

Ai Tobaiasa dahuliyali Labaelela Egebadana tano anda pialu howa Tobaiasahanda lalu, I̱ hamene Asaria-o í̠na i̱ abaleore Laguele andaga haru pobe, lene. Ani lalu dahuliyali biagome ibu Laguele andaga abale haru piyagola Laguele ibuni andahane tagirayagi pabe bu mabu biago tagira haneni berearia hendene. Labaele Tobaiasala libugua bi ala lalu, Í̠ bayale bedebe, lene. Ani layagola Laguelehanda ladai bialu lalu, Libu bayuwa ibiribidago ai andaga tamuha anda ibidaba. I̱ andaga ibiribidago bayuwa ibiribida, lene. Ani lalu Laguele ibugua ogolabo ibu andaga haru anda puwa ibu one Edena olene.
Ibugua Edenahondo lalu, De handa. Igiri ogo ibu dengui i̱ damene Tobidi handalehedago be ani ndodabe, lene.

Ani layagola Edenahanda libuhondo hale halu lalu, Libu ani howa ibiribibe, lene. Ani layagola Tobaiasa Labaelela libugua ladai bialu lalu, Iya Isaraeleali Nabadali hameigini aria íbu henego. Ai áyu iya Asiria dindiha tano timbuni Niniba tano ngagoria minu yu henego ogoreni howa ibiriba lene.

Ani layagola Edenahanda libuhondo hale halu lalu, Ina damene Tobidi mbira kago libu manda bidabibe, lene. Ani layagola libugua lalu, E̱ iya manda bidaba, lene. Ani layagola wali biagome hale halu lalu, Ibu bayale karulape kabe be agua kabe, lene.
Ani hale hayagola libugua ladai bialu lalu, Ibu bayale karulape ka, lene. Ani lowa Tobaiasahanda lalu, Tobidi ibu i̱ aba, lene.
Ani layago hale howa Laguele ibu mogo lalu ibunaga deha de iba abale pugulopebe bini. Ibugua turu timbuni halu Tobaiasa nu̱nu̱ lene.

Ani buwa ibugua lalu, I̱ igini-o Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ mo bayale helo. Í̠ aba ibu agali tigabini bayaleore mbira ka, lene. Anigo ai Tobidi ibu de kohe beda layago hale howa ibugua hale halu lalu, Irane agime agali tigabi bayale ogonibigo ibugua wali agalihondo mana bayale tigabi hangu biaabo halu haga kagonaga denaga hongo ereba hene howa de handabe nahe haruada, lene. Ani lowa ibugua Tobaiasa yu hurubale bialu dugu bini.

Ani biyagola ibu one Edenabi ibu wane Sarabi ti haru Tobidi mitangi bialu dugu biai hene. Ani bialu Laguele ibugua nogo sibi wangabe mbira balu tomo timbuniore dawa manda manda bini. Ai Tobaiasa Labaelela libu wayawaya bai halu tomo nole manda manda bu biruwa Tobaiasa ibugua Labaelehondo lalu, I̱ hamene Asaria-o Sara i̱ dabu buliyanaga í̠na Laguele angi hale holeberebe, lene.
Bi ogoni hale howa Laguele ibugua Tobaiasahondo lamialu lalu,

Tomo nalu iba ala nabe. Ani bialu áyu alendo dege turu holebere. I̱na Sara mulene agali mende nahe Sara dabu bulene i̱ damene aba igini mbiraore í̠ore kegoni ndobe. Anigo ai i̱na í̠hondo tigatigaore laro.

Abale i̱ wane ogoni agali kariali mini. Tibi nde ina hameigini mbiraore dege. Anigo ai ti dabu bigi binidangiore mbiraga Sara tamuha pole wene anda pugu biyagola abale homaga bini. Anigo uruni wahalu Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime libu biamogo bulebirago í̠ áyu tomo ibaru na, lene.

Anigo ai Tobaiasahanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱ tomobi ibabi ala nane bedoore í̠ Sara i̱ nguleore labe, lene. Ani layagola nde Laguele ibugua karulapedalo manda bialu lalu, Heneneore larogo i̱na ibu í̠ ngulebero. Mosesenaga maname bibe ledadagua í̠ ngulebero. Dahuliya andaganaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ibunime dabu bulene ogo manda mandabu heneda. Ai áyu Sara ibu í̠ one berelo libu mandagi halibu. Ai Sara ibu áyu howa í̠naga biraragoni manibi biraabo helo laro. Dahuliya andaganaga Anduane Homogo kago ibunime áyu mbiraga libu handaya ho holebira. Ani bialu libu dara halu biamogo bilo laro, lene.
Tobaiasa ibu Sara dabu binigo ogo

Laguele ibugua ibu wane olene. Ibiyagola Laguelehanda ibu wane gini gi yalu Tobaiasa berearia puwa Anduane Homogohanda libu mo bayale helonaga bi la halu lalu, Wandari ogoni gini yamia. Ai Mosesenaga mana lowini ngadagua wandari ogoni ibu í̠ oneore berelo. Emene howa nde í̠ aba libu dalu haru pialu harigani baya hanguore haru pobe. Libu haru bayale howa turu hagabu haabo halibulonaga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda libu biamogo bulebira, lene.

Laguelehanda ibu onehondo lalu, Beba mbira libu one agaliniore lalu dabu bini lalu gilibu wulenaga mo yalu íbu lene. Edenahanda beba biago mo yalu ibiyagola Laguele ibugua libu dabu binigo habo nalolenenaga bi beba ogoriani gili bialu lalu, I̱na Mosesenaga mana ngagome ledadagua Sara Tobaiasala libu dabu bilo merogoni, lalu gilibu wini.
Tigua uruni biai howa tomo nalu berene.
Mani Laguelehanda ibu one olowa lalu, Tamu hobane mbira mo manda manda bu ngelowa Sara ibu tamu ogoniha haru pobe, lene.

Ani laya handala Edena ibugua tamu hobane mbira mo manda manda bu ngelowa Sara ogoniha haru puwa berelene. Ani berelowa Edenahanda ibu wane dara timbuniore howa dugu bini. Mani ibunaga deha de iba ibiyago domalu howa lalu,

Sara-o miniha genda nahabe. Áyu dahuliya andaga haga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ mo turu halu í̠ miniha daraho bere nalolebira. Ani bulebirago í̠naga mo palia holene karulo birabe, lene. Ani lalu Edena ibu tamu hobane wahalu tagira pene.
